summary.en: Co-founded the company and lead its technical direction, building the engineering team behind its AI-native SaaS platforms.
summary.ar: شارك في تأسيس الشركة ويقود توجهها التقني، ويبني الفريق الهندسي وراء منصاتها السحابية القائمة على الذكاء الاصطناعي.

highlights.en: Architect production SaaS end to end with NestJS 11, Angular 21, Nx and LangGraph.
Set engineering principles around reliability, type safety, enforced module boundaries and rigorous automated testing.
Build and mentor the engineering team behind its AI-native SaaS platforms.

quip.en: Built the team, then built the robots that argue with the team. Productive chaos.
quip.ar: بنى الفريق، وبعدين بنى الروبوتات اللي بتتخانق مع الفريق. فوضى منتجة.

summary.en: Directed the SDLC for key enterprise products, owning architecture and deployment.
summary.ar: أدار دورة حياة تطوير البرمجيات لمنتجات مؤسسية رئيسية، مسؤولًا عن المعمارية والنشر.

highlights.en: Architected the company's SaaS platform and onboarded the Egyptian engineering team.
Drove adoption of micro-frontends and strictly typed backends across products.
Mentored senior engineers and implemented CI/CD pipelines to shorten time to market.

quip.en: Left the codebase stricter than it started. The types are grateful.
quip.ar: ساب الكود أصرم مما استلمه. والأنواع شاكرة فضله.

summary.en: Delivered high-performance web applications and modernised legacy systems for international startups.
summary.ar: قدّم تطبيقات ويب عالية الأداء وحدّث أنظمة قديمة لشركات ناشئة دولية.

highlights.en: Built complex Node.js, NestJS and .NET Core backends for international startups.
Delivered complex Angular/RxJS user interfaces and modernised legacy systems.
Clients included World of Systems & Softwares (Saudi Arabia).

quip.en: Remote since before remote was a personality.
quip.ar: شغّال عن بُعد من قبل ما الشغل عن بُعد يبقى موضة.

summary.en: Built data-intensive web applications and real-time tracking automation for enterprise systems.
summary.ar: بنى تطبيقات ويب كثيفة البيانات وأتمتة للتتبع اللحظي لأنظمة مؤسسية.

highlights.en: Developed data-intensive web apps with AngularJS and ASP.NET Web API.
Built Windows services for real-time data tracking and monitoring automation.

quip.en: Started before signals existed. Survived anyway.
quip.ar: ابتدى قبل ما الـ signals تظهر. وعدّاها برضه.
